description: Show or hide a Cloud for WordPress site from search engines. `visible: false` asks them not to index it (WordPress "discourage search engines"), useful while a site is being built; `true` allows indexing again.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: set_wordpress_search_visibility
title: Set Wordpress Search Visibility
